logp.method_description: Partition coefficients of 1–4 and cisplatin in n-octanol/water were determined by the classical shake flask method using the standard protocol [28]. Two parallel experiments were performed for each sample and the amount of the complexes in the n-octanol phase was analyzed by UV–vis measurements. Partition coefficient (log P) defined as the logarithmic ratio of the equilibrium concentrations of the dissolved complex between the organic and aqueous phases (log CO/CW) was estimated.
